description: This Java source file defines the implementation of an ApplicationClientFactory for Hono, including methods for creating and managing message consumers and command clients, with caching and connection handling.

classes.name: ApplicationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ApplicationClientFactory that creates and manages message consumers and command clients with caching, handling connection lifecycle and external dependencies.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer for a specified tenant, with provided message handling and close handling.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates an event message consumer with a specified message handler or BiConsumer, tenant ID, and close handler.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for a specific tenant, optionally with a reply ID.

methods.name: getOrCreateAsyncCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an asynchronous command client for a tenant.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for async command responses, with specified reply ID, message handler, and close handler.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection by clearing cached client states.
